explanation: Beckett had settled in Paris and wrote it as En attendant Godot, first staged there in 1953. He then made the English version himself.

claims.text: Samuel Beckett first wrote Waiting for Godot in French, as En attendant Godot.
Beckett did not first write the play in English, Irish or German.
Samuel Beckett was born in Dublin, Ireland, and settled in Paris.
En attendant Godot was first staged in Paris in 1953.
Beckett translated Waiting for Godot into English himself.
